name: Portland in a Pyra Tree 2019
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortlandinaPyraTree2019#13080-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Pyraminx is the main event. **Join our facebook group to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!** [![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/8uf2SCt.png)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085/)
